senses.title: The person who guides a group
senses.definition: a person who directs the movement or activity of a group and whom others follow
senses.definitionCN: 指引一个群体的行动或活动、并被他人跟随的人
senses.example: The group chose a new leader before the season began.
senses.exampleCN: 赛季开始前，这个团体选出了一位新的领导者。
senses.why: The verb means 'to cause to go', and the agent ending marks the one who does the causing.
senses.whyCN: 动词意为「使行走」，施事后缀标记的正是那个发出使动的人。

senses.title: The head of an organization or government
senses.definition: the person holding the highest office in a party, union, company or state
senses.definitionCN: 在政党、工会、公司或国家中占据最高职位的人
senses.example: Union leaders met the minister on Tuesday.
senses.exampleCN: 工会领袖们在周二会见了部长。
senses.why: A group large enough to have offices needs a person at the top of its chart, and that person is its leader.
senses.whyCN: 一个大到设有办公室的群体，需要在组织图顶端有一个人，这个人就是它的领导者。

senses.title: The one in front of a race
senses.definition: the competitor currently ahead of all others in a race or contest
senses.definitionCN: 在赛跑或竞赛中目前领先于所有其他人的人
senses.example: The leader pulled away on the final climb.
senses.exampleCN: 领先者在最后一段爬坡时拉开了距离。
senses.why: The same word covers physical position: whoever is furthest along the course is simply the one leading.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也覆盖物理位置：在赛道上走得最远的人，自然就是领跑者。

senses.title: The top firm or product
senses.titleCN: 市场中最领先的企业或产品
senses.definition: the company or brand with the largest share or strongest position in a market
senses.definitionCN: 在市场中份额最大或地位最强的公司或品牌
senses.example: The company is the market leader in small turbines.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司是小型涡轮机市场的领先者。
senses.why: Markets are treated as races, so the firm furthest ahead carries the name of the runner in front.
senses.whyCN: 市场被当作赛跑，因此跑得最远的公司就带上了最前面那位选手的名称。

senses.title: A leading newspaper article
senses.definition: in British usage, the main editorial that states the paper's opinion
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法中指表明报纸立场的主要社论
senses.example: The newspaper's leader criticized the plan as too costly.
senses.exampleCN: 该报的社论批评这项计划代价过高。
senses.why: The article that stands at the head of the opinion page is literally the leading piece.
senses.whyCN: 站在评论版最前面的那篇文章，字面上就是「领头的」那篇。

senses.title: The line between fly and fish
senses.titleCN: 鱼线与假饵之间的前导线
senses.definition: in angling, the length of line attached between the main line and the hook or fly
senses.definitionCN: 钓鱼时连接主线与鱼钩或假饵的那段线
senses.example: He tied a longer leader to the fly line before casting.
senses.exampleCN: 抛竿之前，他在飞蝇线上接了一段更长的前导线。
senses.why: The leader goes in front of the main line and leads the fly to the fish, so angling borrowed the ordinary word.
senses.whyCN: 前导线走在主线之前，把假饵引向鱼，钓鱼术语因此借用了这个普通词。

senses.title: The first chair in an orchestra
senses.definition: the principal player, especially the first violinist, who leads the section and stands in for the conductor
senses.definitionCN: 主要演奏者，尤指首席小提琴手，负责带领声部并在需要时代行指挥
senses.example: The orchestra's leader tuned the strings before the overture.
senses.exampleCN: 乐团首席在序曲之前为弦乐调音。
senses.why: Music uses the word for the player who stands first and gives the cue to the section.
senses.whyCN: 音乐用这个词指站在最前面、向声部发出提示的演奏者。

senses.title: The person who takes a group up a mountain
senses.definition: a qualified person who guides a group along a route and takes responsibility for its safety
senses.definitionCN: 沿路线引导团队并对安全负责的合格人员
senses.example: The mountain leader checked every rope before the descent.
senses.exampleCN: 登山向导在下撤之前检查了每一根绳索。
senses.why: Guidance on a route is the oldest sense of leading: someone who knows the way walks in front.
senses.whyCN: 在路线上引导是「带领」最古老的义项：知道路的人走在前面。

intro.en: Leader is lead plus the agent ending -er. Lead comes from Old English lǣdan 'to lead, guide', a causative form related to līþan 'to go, travel'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: leader 由 lead 加施事后缀构成。lead 出自古英语 lǣdan「带领、引导」，是与 līþan「行走、旅行」相关的使役形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Līþan meant 'to go, travel'. Its earlier Germanic source is reconstructed rather than directly attested.
items.cn: līþan 意为「行走、旅行」。它在日耳曼语中更早的来源属于重构，而非直接有据。

items.en: Lǣdan was the causative partner, meaning 'to make go, conduct, guide'.
items.cn: lǣdan 是对应的使役词，意为「使行走、引导、带领」。

items.en: The ending -er marks the doer. English had a native agent ending, later reinforced by French -ier from Latin -arius.
items.cn: 这个施事后缀标记动作的执行者。英语本有本土的施事后缀，后来受到法语中源自拉丁语的相应后缀加强。

items.en: Leader named the person who conducts others, and by the seventeenth century it also named the first person in a race.
items.cn: leader 指带领他人的人；到十七世纪，它也指赛跑中最前面的人。

items.en: Angling, music and journalism each gave the word a narrow use, from the line before the fly to the article before the editorial page.
items.cn: 钓鱼、音乐与新闻各自赋予这个词专门用法，从假饵之前的线，到评论版最前面的文章。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Germanic source of līþan is a reconstruction, and no exact first citation is fixed for the angling sense, so dates here are approximations.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：līþan 在日耳曼语之前的来源属于重构形式；钓鱼义也没有确切的最早书证，因此这里给出的年代均为约数。

note.en: Group one holds the same guiding family; group two holds nouns for the person at the head of a group.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「引导」词族的词；第二组是表示群体首位者的名词。

entries.definition: To guide or be first; the person noun is built directly on this verb.
entries.definitionCN: 引导或处于首位；这个表示人的名词直接由该动词构成。

entries.definition: Means guiding or ahead; it describes the position rather than the person.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「引导的」或「领先的」；描述位置，而非人。

entries.definition: The ability, position or body of leaders; it surrounds the person with a role.
entries.definitionCN: 领导能力、职位或领导层；它把这个人包在一个角色里。

entries.definition: To guide in the wrong direction; it shares the walking root but reverses the purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 把人引向错误方向；共享「行走」词根，却把目的反转。

entries.definition: The person in charge of an organization; it stresses office more than the act of guiding.
entries.definitionCN: 一个组织的主管者；强调职位，而非引导的动作。

entries.definition: The highest-ranking person in a body, often in a traditional or official title.
entries.definitionCN: 某个机构中地位最高的人，常用于传统或官方头衔。

entries.definition: A person who opens a new field or route; a leader can follow an existing path, a pioneer cannot.
entries.definitionCN: 开辟新领域或新路线的人；领导者可以走已有的路，先驱则不能。

entries.definition: The competitor thought most likely to win; it is close to the race sense of leader.
entries.definitionCN: 被认为最可能获胜的竞争者；接近 leader 的赛跑义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real walking root, the real agent ending and the real institutional phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「行走」词根、真实的施事后缀与真实的机构搭配。

normal.en: The verb means 'to cause to go', and the ending means 'the one who', so a leader is the one who makes others go.
normal.cn: 动词意为「使行走」，后缀意为「……的人」，因此领导者就是使他人前进的人。

normal.en: The family runs lead, leader, leading, led, leadership, mislead and leaderless.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 lead、leader、leading、led、leadership、mislead 与 leaderless。

normal.en: The organizational phrases are team leader, world leader and leader of the opposition.
normal.cn: 组织搭配有团队负责人、世界领导人与反对党领袖。

normal.en: The market phrase is market leader, and the everyday phrase is follow the leader.
normal.cn: 市场搭配是市场领先者，日常说法是跟着领头的人做。

normal.en: The same root appears in mislead, where the guiding is deliberately wrong.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 mislead 中，那里的引导是故意走错方向。

abstract.en: Picture someone at the front of a column who turns back to count the walkers.
abstract.cn: 想象队伍最前面的人回头清点人数。

abstract.en: Picture a runner whose back is the only thing the others can see.
abstract.cn: 想象一名跑者，其他人只看得见他的背影。

abstract.en: Picture a first violinist raising the bow so that an entire section know when to begin.
abstract.cn: 想象首席小提琴手举起弓，让整个声部知道何时开始。

examples.en: A good leader makes the next decision easier for everyone else.
examples.cn: 好的领导者会让其他人做下一个决定时更容易。

examples.en: The market leader cut prices before the smaller firms could respond.
examples.cn: 市场领先者在较小公司来得及反应之前就降了价。

examples.en: The newspaper's leader called for an independent inquiry.
examples.cn: 该报的社论要求进行独立调查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「带领」加「人」——走在最前、让别人跟着走的那个人 → 领导者、领先者

root: leader 由 lead 加施事后缀构成。lead 出自古英语 lǣdan「带领」，与 līþan「行走」相关的使役形式；这个后缀标记执行者。更早的日耳曼来源属于重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one figure: the one who goes first. The figure is a guide of people, a head of an institution, a runner in front, a top firm, a leading article, a line ahead of the fly, a first violinist and a mountain guide.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个人物展开：走在最前面的那一个。这个人物依次是人群的引导者、机构首脑、跑在前面的选手、顶尖企业、头篇评论、假饵前的线、首席小提琴手与登山向导。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the walker at the front who turns to check the column.
core.cn: 核心意象：走在最前面、回头清点队伍的人。

branches.en: THE GUIDE: whether on a trail or in a meeting, the leader is the one who knows the way and walks ahead.
branches.cn: 向导：无论在林间小径上还是在会议中，领导者都是识路并走在前面的人。

branches.en: THE OFFICE: a large body needs a person at the top of its chart.
branches.cn: 职位：庞大的机构需要在组织图顶端有一个人。

branches.en: THE FRONT: a race and a market both measure who is furthest ahead.
branches.cn: 最前：赛跑与市场都在衡量谁跑得最远。

branches.en: THE LEADING WORD: the article at the head of the opinion page speaks for the paper.
branches.cn: 领头之言：评论版最前面的文章代表报纸发言。

branches.en: THE FIRST IN LINE: a fishing trace and a first violin both stand ahead of the rest.
branches.cn: 队列之首：钓鱼前导线与首席小提琴都站在其余之前。

intro.en: The noun can be read from an Old English verb of going, its causative partner and the agent ending that marks the doer.
intro.cn: 这个名词可以按表示行走的古英语动词、它的使役对应词以及标记执行者的施事后缀逐段读出。

latinIntro.en: This word is native English rather than Latin: the Germanic walking root supplies the verb, and the agent ending marks the person.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是英语本族词而非拉丁借词：日耳曼语中表示行走的词根提供动词，施事后缀标记人。

items.example: The old verb named ordinary movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个古动词指普通移动。

items.example: The causative verb added the idea of conducting others.
items.exampleCN: 这个使役动词增添了带领他人的意思。

items.example: He led the team through the gate.
The ending marks the person who performs the action.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀标记执行动作的人。

items.example: The leader waited at the fork in the path.
The leading car turned off the highway.
items.exampleCN: 领头的那辆车驶离了公路。

items.example: She led the group down the ridge.
The team turned to her for leadership.
A false sign misled the hikers.
items.exampleCN: 一块错误的牌子误导了徒步者。
这个没有领导的群体逐渐散开。

definition_zh: 领导；领导能力；领导层；领导地位
definition_en: the ability or activity of guiding a group, or the people who hold that role
core_image: 队伍最前面的人举着火把，后面的人跟着那点光走，暗处的路看不清
scene: 夜路上，走在最前面的人举着火把，后面的人跟着那点光前进。Her leadership turned a divided committee into a working team.
sceneCN: 这里指「带领群体行动的领导能力」（第 1 个义项：引导群体的能力）；句意为她的领导力把一个分裂的委员会变成了能运转的团队。可辨识物件：火把、夜路、队伍、前方拐角、脚印。

领导层；领导班子（集合名词）

senses.title: The ability to guide a group
senses.definition: the capacity to set a direction and keep a group working toward it
senses.definitionCN: 确定方向并使一个群体朝该方向持续行动的能力
senses.example: Her leadership turned a divided committee into a working team.
senses.exampleCN: 她的领导力把一个分裂的委员会变成了能运转的团队。
senses.why: The verb behind the word means 'to cause to go'; leadership is the ability to make a group go in one direction.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的动词意为「使行走」；领导力就是使一个群体朝同一方向前进的能力。

senses.title: The position of leader
senses.definition: the office or role of being the person who directs a group
senses.definitionCN: 指导一个群体的那个人所占据的职位或角色
senses.example: He assumed leadership of the party after the election.
senses.exampleCN: 选举之后，他接任了该党的领导职务。
senses.why: The suffix turns a person into a state: being a leader is a role that can be entered and left.
senses.whyCN: 后缀把人变成一种状态：做领导者是一个可以进入也可以离开的角色。

senses.title: The group at the top
senses.definition: the collective body of people who hold the highest directing roles in an organization
senses.definitionCN: 在一个组织中占据最高指导职位的集体
senses.example: The leadership met behind closed doors before the vote.
senses.exampleCN: 投票之前，领导层闭门开会。
senses.why: English often treats a set of office-holders as one collective noun, so the role becomes a body.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把一群任职者当作一个集合名词，于是职位变成了一个机构。

senses.title: A way of leading
senses.definition: a characteristic manner of directing others, such as coaching, directing or delegating
senses.definitionCN: 指导他人的典型方式，如教练式、指挥式或授权式
senses.example: A coaching style of leadership improved staff retention.
senses.exampleCN: 教练式的领导风格提高了员工留任率。
senses.why: Once leadership is studied, its manners are classified, and each one becomes a named style.
senses.whyCN: 一旦领导被研究，它的做法就会被分类，每一种做法都成为一个有名称的风格。

senses.title: Direction at the level of government
senses.definition: the activity of setting public direction and taking responsibility for national or local decisions
senses.definitionCN: 确定公共方向并为国家或地方决策承担责任的活动
senses.example: Political leadership was slow to recognize the drought.
senses.exampleCN: 政治领导层迟迟没有认识到旱情的严重。
senses.why: The word moves easily from a team to a state, because both need someone to set a course.
senses.whyCN: 这个词很容易从团队移到国家，因为两者都需要有人确定航向。

senses.title: Authority of ideas in an industry
senses.definition: the reputation of shaping how an industry thinks, often built through research and public comment
senses.definitionCN: 塑造一个行业思考方式的声誉，常通过研究与公开发言建立
senses.example: The firm publishes reports to establish thought leadership in the field.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司发布报告，以在该领域建立思想领导力。
senses.why: Leading need not mean commanding; whoever defines the questions can lead an industry's attention.
senses.whyCN: 领导不必意味着命令；能界定问题的人就能引导一个行业的注意力。

senses.title: First place in a market
senses.definition: the position of having the largest share or the strongest reputation in a market
senses.definitionCN: 在市场中获得最大份额或最强声誉的位置
senses.example: The brand lost market leadership after the recall.
senses.exampleCN: 召回事件之后，这个品牌失去了市场领先地位。
senses.why: Competition borrows the image of a race: the leader is simply the one furthest ahead.
senses.whyCN: 竞争借用了赛跑的意象：领先者就是跑在最前面的那一个。

senses.title: Keeping a group together in difficulty
senses.titleCN: 困境中维持群体的凝聚
senses.definition: the work of holding a group together and making it continue when conditions are hard
senses.definitionCN: 在艰难条件下维持群体并使其继续前进的工作
senses.example: Leadership in a storm means keeping the group together, not walking fastest.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴中的领导意味着让队伍保持在一起，而不是自己走得最快。
senses.why: The oldest image is a person walking ahead with a light; the point is not speed but that others can still follow.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意象是一个人举着光走在前面；重点不是速度，而是后来的人仍能跟上。

intro.en: Leadership joins leader with the noun suffix -ship. Leader comes from the verb lead, from Old English lǣdan 'to lead, guide', a causative form related to līþan 'to go, travel'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: leadership 由 leader 加名词后缀构成。leader 来自动词 lead，后者出自古英语 lǣdan「带领、引导」，是与 līþan「行走、旅行」相关的使役形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Līþan meant 'to go, travel'. Its earlier Germanic source is reconstructed rather than directly attested.
items.cn: līþan 意为「行走、旅行」。它在日耳曼语中更早的来源属于重构，而非直接有据。

items.en: Lǣdan was the causative partner of līþan, meaning 'to make go, conduct, guide'.
items.cn: lǣdan 是 līþan 的使役对应词，意为「使行走、引导、带领」。

items.en: The verb lead survived into Middle English and extended from guiding people to being first in a race or market.
items.cn: 动词 lead 进入中古英语，并从引导人扩展到在竞赛或市场中领先。

items.en: Leader named the person who conducts others, formed from the verb with an agent ending.
items.cn: leader 指带领他人的人，由动词加施事后缀构成。

items.en: The ending -ship comes from Old English -scipe, meaning 'state or condition', so leadership is the state of being a leader.
items.cn: 这个名词后缀来自古英语中表示「状态或境况」的相应后缀，因此 leadership 就是身为领导者的状态。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Germanic source of līþan is a reconstruction, and no exact first citation is fixed for the modern managerial sense, so dates here are approximations.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：līþan 在日耳曼语之前的来源属于重构形式；现代管理义也没有确切的最早书证，因此这里给出的年代均为约数。

note.en: Group one holds the same guiding family in other grammatical roles; group two holds nouns for directing people and work.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「引导」词族、语法角色不同的词；第二组是指挥人与工作的名词。

entries.definition: The person who guides a group; leadership is the role, ability or body that surrounds that person.
entries.definitionCN: 引导群体的人；leadership 是围绕这个人的角色、能力或集体。

entries.definition: To guide or be first; it names the action from which the noun is built.
entries.definitionCN: 引导或处于首位；它指构成这个名词的动作。

entries.definition: Means guiding or being ahead; as an adjective it describes the front position.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「引导的」或「领先的」；作形容词时描述最前的位置。

entries.definition: To guide someone in the wrong direction; it shares the same walking root but adds a prefix of error.
entries.definitionCN: 把人引向错误方向；共享同一个「行走」词根，只是加上表示错误的前缀。

entries.definition: The activity of planning and controlling resources; leadership sets direction, management maintains the system.
entries.definitionCN: 计划与控制资源的活动；领导确定方向，管理维持系统。

entries.definition: Advice or direction given to someone who needs to find a path; it is usually less formal than leadership.
entries.definitionCN: 给需要找路的人以建议或方向；通常比 leadership 更不正式。

entries.definition: The course or line along which something moves; leadership is the act of setting that course.
entries.definitionCN: 某物前进的路线或方向；leadership 是设定这条路线的行为。

entries.definition: Recognized power to command; a leader may have authority, but leadership can exist without it.
entries.definitionCN: 被承认的命令权；领导者可以拥有权威，但领导力也能在没有权威时存在。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real walking root, the real suffix and the real organizational phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「行走」词根、真实的后缀与真实的组织搭配。

normal.en: The verb means 'to cause to go', so leadership is the ability to make a group go forward together.
normal.cn: 动词意为「使行走」，因此领导力就是使一个群体共同前进的能力。

normal.en: The suffix means 'state or condition', so leadership is literally the state of being a leader.
normal.cn: 后缀意为「状态或境况」，因此 leadership 字面上就是身为领导者的状态。

normal.en: The family runs lead, leader, leading, led, leadership and mislead.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 lead、leader、leading、led、leadership 与 mislead。

normal.en: The organizational phrases are under the leadership of, strong leadership and leadership style.
normal.cn: 组织搭配有在……的领导下、强有力的领导与领导风格。

normal.en: The political and business phrases are party leadership, market leadership and thought leadership.
normal.cn: 政治与商业搭配有党的领导层、市场领先地位与思想领导力。

abstract.en: Picture a torch at the front of a night column, visible just far enough to follow.
abstract.cn: 想象夜行队伍最前面的一支火把，光刚好够后面的人跟着走。

abstract.en: Picture a committee split into two rooms until one person brings both back to the same table.
abstract.cn: 想象一个委员会分裂在两个房间，直到有人把双方带回同一张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a storm where the slowest walker sets the pace and no one is left behind.
abstract.cn: 想象一场风暴，最慢的人决定速度，没有人被落下。

examples.en: The school needs stable leadership before it can change the curriculum.
examples.cn: 学校需要稳定的领导层，才能改变课程。

examples.en: She studied leadership in small teams rather than in large corporations.
examples.cn: 她研究的是小团队中的领导，而非大公司中的领导。

examples.en: Under his leadership, the clinic doubled the number of patients it could see.
examples.cn: 在他的领导下，诊所能够接诊的病人数量翻了一倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「带领」加「身份状态」——走在最前面并让后面的人跟上来 → 领导、领导力

root: leadership 由 leader 加名词后缀构成。leader 来自动词 lead，出自古英语 lǣdan「带领」，与 līþan「行走」相关的使役形式；这个名词后缀来自古英语中表示「状态」的相应后缀。更早的日耳曼来源属于重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one image: someone walks in front with a light. The image becomes an ability, a position, a body of leaders, a manner, a government's direction, an industry's authority, a market's first place and finally the work of keeping a group together in a storm.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个意象展开：有人举着光走在前面。这个意象依次变成能力、职位、领导班子、方式、政府的方向、行业的思想权威、市场的首位，最后是在风暴中维持群体不散的工作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a torch carried at the head of a night column.
core.cn: 核心意象：夜行队伍最前面的一支火把。

branches.en: THE ABILITY: the first sense is the capacity to set a direction and keep others moving.
branches.cn: 能力：第一个义项是确定方向并使他人持续前进的能力。

branches.en: THE ROLE AND THE STORM: holding the office and holding the group together are two sides of the same walk.
branches.cn: 职位与风暴：占据职位与维持群体不散，是同一次行走的两面。

branches.en: THE BODY: a set of office-holders becomes a collective noun with its own meetings.
branches.cn: 集体：一群任职者变成一个拥有自己会议的集合名词。

branches.en: THE MANNER AND THE MIND: coaching a team and shaping an industry's questions are both ways of leading.
branches.cn: 方式与思想：教练一个团队与塑造一个行业的问题，都是领导的方式。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC RACE: a government sets a national course, and a brand runs first in its market.
branches.cn: 公共赛跑：政府确定国家航向，品牌在其市场中跑在最前。

intro.en: The noun can be read from an Old English verb of going, its causative partner, an agent noun and the suffix of state.
intro.cn: 这个名词可以按表示行走的古英语动词、它的使役对应词、施事名词以及表示状态的后缀逐段读出。

latinIntro.en: This word is native English rather than Latin: the Germanic walking root supplies lead, leader and leadership, and the state suffix comes from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是英语本族词而非拉丁借词：日耳曼语中表示行走的词根衍生 lead、leader 与 leadership，表示状态的后缀来自古英语。

items.example: The old verb named ordinary movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个古动词指普通的移动。

items.example: The causative verb added the idea of causing others to move.
items.exampleCN: 这个使役动词增添了使他人移动的意思。

items.example: She led the group through the pass.
The leader set the pace for the climb.
The leading runner never looked back.
items.exampleCN: 跑在最前面的选手从未回头。

items.example: The guide led us to the ridge.

items.meaning: the state or activity of leading
items.example: The team needed leadership after the loss.
items.exampleCN: 失利之后，这个团队需要领导。

items.example: The suffix turns a person into a role.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把一个人变成一种角色。

items.meaning: to guide in the wrong direction
items.example: The sign misled drivers into the closed road.
items.exampleCN: 那块牌子把司机引进了封闭的道路。
